svg.title: Pipeline for AI-assisted extraction of tadpole traits
svg.text: AI-assisted extraction of tadpole life-history traits from the literature
Every value carries its source, the verbatim sentence that supports it, and the model and prompt that produced it.
traits with a closed vocabulary are
names, some limited to one work;
names that could point to another
species go to review. Used to
in retrieval and in the value-agent
OpenAlex (exact phrase in title, abstract and text) and Crossref (kept only
with the binomial in the title); record-type filter; queries in Portuguese,
Binomial in the title: relevant. Otherwise Haiku 4.5 reads title and abstract;
probabilities between 0.35 and 0.75, and failed calls, go to a human.
Unpaywall; a download is kept only if it is a
real PDF. Posters and conference abstracts are
Works without an open PDF are listed in a
spreadsheet; the PDFs the group obtains are
imported as copies, originals untouched. No
Scanned works with too little text go through OCR
Paragraphs, tables and captions become separate
chunks, in document order. Subsections inherit
the main heading (e.g. Methods / Study area).
Each 'Table N' caption opens a table chunk read
from the PDF layout. GROBID loses tables printed
If GROBID fails or returns a TEI without body
text, the page text of the PDF is used.
Chunks naming the species (accepted name, synonym
or abbreviation) and a trait term, ranked by
BM25; top 4 per species × trait × work.
A species named in one paragraph is carried to
the next ones (up to 3) until another species of
A table that cites the species always gets a slot
Sonnet 5.5 reads the Methods or, in notes without
Methods, the passages citing Gosner or stage;
returns stage, setting and sample size. Escalates
to Opus 5.5 when stage or setting is missing.
Sonnet 5.5 returns a value from the closed
vocabulary and the verbatim sentence; never
computes, converts or infers. Escalates to
Opus 5.5 only if the call fails: the sentence is
a required field, so 'not found' never escalates
The sentence must exist, character by character,
in the chunk. The only automatic barrier against
Out-of-range values are flagged. Within a work,
equal values collapse into one record and
conflicting ones go to a human.
The oldest work reporting a value is primary; a
citation in the sentence marks it secondary.
Posters and abstracts are never primary.
Per-trait confidence threshold calibrated on a
Adjudication of disagreements with the reference;
review queue for values below threshold.
A failed API call stops the run. It never becomes
Status on 2 October 2026; pilot on 4 works, 276 species × trait pairs (docs/piloto-zero.md).
